title: Same Facts, Different Diagnosis: Measuring and Mitigating Narrative Anchoring in Clinical Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring 'Narrative Anchoring' by isolating changes in sociolinguistic register as the sole variable in clinical vignettes and evaluating how much a model's diagnostic outputs (Option Match Rate and Diagnostic Stability Score) diverge compared to a control baseline.

Rewriting USMLE clinical vignettes into a socioeconomic persona framed through financial or occupational strain, without using explicit income or demographic markers, and comparing diagnostic accuracy against a neutral control register.

Rewriting USMLE clinical vignettes into a cultural persona that expresses symptoms through culturally situated metaphors and framing, without using explicit cultural identity labels, and comparing diagnostic accuracy against a neutral control register.
